name: Musée National du Burkina Faso
known: Mission: to collect and conserve the material and immaterial witnesses of the country's ethnocultural communities and to teach Burkinabè people about their heritage (Director General Sabari Christian Dao, Lefaso.net, 3 November 2024).
Attendance: more than 30,000 visits from January to October 2024, according to the director (Lefaso.net, 3 November 2024).
December 2018: staff reminded the new director, Rasmata Sawadogo, of the challenge of raising the museum's budget (Burkina24, 7 December 2018).
Its director says partners rarely back museums.

name: Sa Sa Art Projects
known: The co-founders include Khvay Samnang, Lim Sokchanlina and Vuth Lyno (Biennale of Sydney).
Its about page names Reiko Fukutake as founder.

name: Angkor Panorama Museum
known: Profit terms, stated by the museum's director in 2016: Mansudae takes the profits for ten years, then splits them equally with APSARA for ten more, after which the museum passes to the Cambodian government (Al Jazeera).
The museum director gave the cost and profit terms to Al Jazeera on 22 February 2016.

name: Bandjoun Station
known: Founded by the artist Barthélémy Toguo, who describes it as a "laboratoire sans frontières" (Africultures, translation).
Toguo is artistic director, Germain Noubi managing director and Carine Djuidje handles cultural mediation (Contemporary And).

name: doual'art
known: Douala Bell is president, and Schaub was artistic director until his death in 2014 (Wikipedia).

name: Musée National du Cameroun
known: The director is Professor Hugues Heumen Tchana, who also coordinates the modernisation project Padmun (Cameroon Tribune, 3 December 2024).

Its work covered governance (organisation chart, communication policy), collections and reserves (inventory, conservation), a scientific and cultural policy, and museographical and architectural pre-programming of the spaces (Expertise France).

name: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity
known: Chris Lorway has been CEO since April 2023, after Janice Price.
Alberta fired the whole board in October 2023, including chair Adam Waterous, executive chairman of oil producer Strathcona Resources, after a harassment complaint against him.

name: Contemporary Calgary
known: Peter Tertzakian, a Leadership Circle donor and former chair of the gallery's board, is the founder of the ARC Energy Research Institute and a partner of ARC Financial Corp. (ARC Energy Institute).
Board: co-chairs Carol Ryder and Kelly Streit, secretary Margaret-Jean Mannix, treasurer Krista Rabidoux, and directors including Rick Orman and Alan Ross;
David Leinster is CEO (stated by the gallery).

name: Glenbow
known: The reopened museum plans 44 exhibitions and displays on eight floors, visible storage, a conservation lab, a new Blackfoot Gallery curated with Elders from Siksika, Piikani, Kainai and Blackfeet Nation, a theatre, shop and restaurant (stated by the space).
Board member Heather Shaw, Executive Chair of Corus Entertainment, is a director of that foundation (stated by the space).
